metadata.title: Herbs & Spices — Herb & Spice Category

narrative.introduction: The Herb & Spice Ontology catalogs canonical culinary herbs and spices used worldwide as ingredients. This domain models culinary ingredients, not botanical taxonomy.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary herbs and spices by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary herbs and spices across four immutable groups: Fresh Herbs, Dried Herbs, Whole Spices, and Ground & Blended Spices.
